philippines.title: Sept. 23 lotto results: ₱219.84M Grand Lotto jackpot not won
philippines.description:
MANILA, Philippines — No bettor won the Grand Lotto 6/55 or Mega Lotto 6/45 jackpot in the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) draws Wednesday, Sept. 23. According to the PCSO results provided, the Grand Lotto 6/55 winning combination was 29-47-22-32-50-46 for a jackpot of ₱219.84 million. No ticket matched all six numbers. The Mega Lotto 6/45 combination was 44-05-04-40-45-07, with a jackpot of ₱71.19 million. No bettor won the top prize. philippines.title: Bomb threat prompts FEU Manila to suspend classes
philippines.description:
MANILA, Philippines — Classes at Far Eastern University (FEU) Manila were suspended late Wednesday, Sept. 23, as a precautionary measure following a reported bomb threat. In an advisory released at 8:20 p.m., the university’s Manila campus announced the suspension after reportedly receiving a bomb threat. “Students, faculty, employees, and support staff are advised to evacuate the campus calmly and in an orderly manner and follow the instructions of security personnel,” it said in the advisory. philippines.title: Barbers: House prosecution banking on evidence, not lower vote threshold
philippines.description:
MANILA, Philippines — The House prosecution is confident that its evidence can secure the conviction of Vice President Sara Duterte in her impeachment trial, rather than relying on a lower voting threshold, former Rep.
